name: Requisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
“A swift grift is a thrifty gift”. Such is a phrase often uttered by requisitors. To achieve their ends, a requisitor justifies theft and robbery by portraying such actions as religious protocols and lawful procedures, even if they might not be.

Always requiring more and more resources, her church gives her the support she needs to a mutual benefit.

Class Skills: A requisitor gains Appraise and Sleight of Hand as class skills. She does not gain Ride or Survival as class skills.

This alters class skills.

Requisition

At 1st level, and each level thereafter, the requisitor receives an allowance of 500 gp per level from her religious institution. This allowance increases to 1,000 gp per level at 6th level. This money is expected to “stay within the church”, meaning it can only be spent on equipment and property that are used and owned by the requisitor. The requisitor is forbidden from using their allowance money to purchase services or items that have limited uses. When a requisitor dies, all of her property is requisitioned back by her church.

This replaces domain.

Subjugate

At 3rd level, a requisitor gains Improved Steal as a bonus feat, even if she does not meet its prerequisites. She also qualifies for the Greater Steal feat at 7th level.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 3rd level.

Confiscate (Sp)

Starting at 5th level, a requisitor can use obscure object, as per the spell, a number of times per day equal to her legendary inquisitor level. The duration of this spell-like ability can remain in effect past the normal 8-hour limit as long as the requisitor keeps the confiscated object on her person.

This replaces discern lies.
